The process

How we’ll
work together.

01 / Understand

First, the conversation.

We discuss your business, audience and what you need the project to achieve.

02 / Agree & build

Then, a clear scope.

Deliverables, cost and timeline are agreed before the work begins. You see the work as it develops.

03 / Test & hand over

Finally, make it usable.

We review the details, test the agreed flows and cover what you need to manage it.
